messages:
maya (Billing): heads up — Pelotonix (ACCT-PX9) payment failed for INV-2026-05-210 ($9,240). card declined twice. customer asked to split into 3 installments and disputed one high-cost embed job.
oliver (AE): talked to their controller (sasha). admits they ran a debug pipeline by mistake. wants 3-pay and to push first payment 14 days.
sam (Collections): we can entertain splits but need signed email + reconciliation confirmation. no credits until billing signs off.
legal-bot: Template: include clause that missed installment accelerates balance and preserves termination rights.
maya (Billing): note: credits > $1k need finance manager OK. this invoice has a disputed line ~ $1,200.
oliver (AE): proposed plan: 33/33/34, first payment 2026-06-10. I'll send draft and request signed reply.
dunning-bot: Automated: reminder scheduled for INV-2026-05-210 unless payment_plan flag set (next run 2175003600).
sam (Collections): once signed, set payment_plan:pending and I'll mute dunning. oliver drop the signed text here when you get it.
oliver (AE): will do — sending now. thanks.
